Name: Hollowstyx Tiny Birds for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
I found Hollowstyx's old [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7046]Banties and Quails for Adopt'N'Skin[/url] since permissions were open I thought I'd bring them back! 

This mod gives you a whopping 34 birds to choose from: 

- 12 hens that produce eggs
- 10 roosters that dig up bug meat and clay
- 7 female quails that produce quail eggs that can be turned into mayonnaise
- 2 male quails that will dig up mixed seeds and fiber
- 1 dove that finds worms and lays eggs
- 2 penguins that produce bait and eggs that can be turned into mayonnaise

They all live in regular coops and can be bought from Marnie.

Enjoy!
